title: 二級沉澱池污泥控制~Sludge control in secondary clarifiers
focus: 二沉池固體通量、泥毯與回排泥~Secondary-clarifier solids flux, blanket and sludge return/wasting
summary: 本課以二沉池固體通量、泥毯與回排泥為主線，從混合液固體進入、沉降指標與曲線、回流濃度平衡、水力與固體雙限制進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops secondary-clarifier solids flux, blanket and sludge return/wasting through ten connected units, beginning with mixed-liquor solids input, settleability and curves, return-sludge concentration balance, hydraulic and solids constraints. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 混合液固體進入~Mixed-liquor solids input
units.mechanism: 二沉池處理混合液與回流循環的固體通量，不能只看出流水量。~Secondary clarification handles mixed-liquor/recycle solids flux, not effluent flow alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q+Qr=5000 m³/d；X=3 kg/m³；A=200 m²。模型 SLR=(Q+Qr)X/A，代入得到 75 kg solids/(m²·d)。適用邊界：固體表面負荷須搭配沉降曲線，不能只看水力溢流率。~Original teaching assumptions: Q+Qr=5000 m³/d; X=3 kg/m³; A=200 m². Model SLR=(Q+Qr)X/A gives 75 kg solids/(m²·d). Applicability: Solids loading requires a settling curve, not only hydraulic overflow rate.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「混合液固體進入」的觀測點。量混合液固體與回流，並畫固體通量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for mixed-liquor solids input. Measure mixed-liquor solids/recycle and construct a solids-flux plot. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 漏算回流造成固體負荷低估。診斷與介入：把回流及混合液濃度都列入，查分池負荷不均。~Omitting recycle understates solids loading. Diagnostic response: Include recycle and mixed-liquor concentration and check cell-load imbalance.
units.misconception: 固體負荷只由進廠水量決定。~Plant influent flow alone determines clarifier solids loading.
units.practice: 只改變 X:3→3.5 kg/m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 75 變為 87.5 kg solids/(m²·d)。用「混合液固體進入」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only X:3→3.5 kg/m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 75 to 87.5 kg solids/(m²·d). Explain the direction using mixed-liquor solids input, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 沉降指標與曲線~Settleability and curves
units.mechanism: SVI 是批次指標，須搭配完整沉降曲線與濃度，避免單數值定性。~SVI is a batch indicator; pair it with a full curve and concentration rather than labeling from one number.
units.model: 原創教學假設：30 min 沉降體積=300 mL/L；MLSS=3 g/L。模型 SVI=V30/X，代入得到 100 mL/g。適用邊界：單一批次沉降指標，受濃度、絮體與稀釋方法影響。~Original teaching assumptions: 30-minute settled volume=300 mL/L; MLSS=3 g/L. Model SVI=V30/X gives 100 mL/g. Applicability: Batch settleability indicator affected by concentration, floc and dilution method.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「沉降指標與曲線」的觀測點。記錄量筒、溫度、沉降曲線與稀釋程序。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for settleability and curves. Record cylinder, temperature, settling curve and dilution procedure. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 高濃度阻礙沉降被錯認為絲狀菌膨化。診斷與介入：補做完整沉降曲線及顯微觀察，不由 SVI 單點定性。~Concentration-hindered settling is mistaken for filamentous bulking. Diagnostic response: Add full settling curves/microscopy rather than diagnosing from one SVI value.
units.misconception: 同一 SVI 代表相同污泥性質。~The same SVI means identical sludge properties.
units.practice: 只改變 V30:300→450 mL/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 100 變為 150 mL/g。用「沉降指標與曲線」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only V30:300→450 mL/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 100 to 150 mL/g. Explain the direction using settleability and curves, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 回流濃度平衡~Return-sludge concentration balance
units.mechanism: 回流量與回流濃度共同維持菌體循環，池底庫存仍需獨立追蹤。~Return flow and concentration maintain biomass cycling while blanket inventory needs separate tracking.
units.model: 原創教學假設：混合液 X=3 kg/m³；回流 XR=8 kg/m³。模型 R=X/(XR-X)，代入得到 0.6 ratio。適用邊界：簡化穩態沉澱池平衡，忽略排泥、出流水固體與庫存變化。~Original teaching assumptions: Mixed liquor X=3 kg/m³; return sludge XR=8 kg/m³. Model R=X/(XR-X) gives 0.6 ratio. Applicability: Simplified steady clarifier balance, omitting wasting, effluent solids and storage changes.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「回流濃度平衡」的觀測點。以池底庫存與出流固體檢查簡化假設。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for return-sludge concentration balance. Check assumptions against blanket inventory and effluent solids. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只增加回流而未看沉澱能力。診斷與介入：將回流濃度、泥毯及出水固體一起檢查。~Increasing recycle without checking settling capacity fails. Diagnostic response: Check return concentration, blanket and effluent solids together.
units.misconception: 回流增加永遠降低固體負荷。~More recycle always lowers solids loading.
units.practice: 只改變 XR:8→7 kg/m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.6 變為 0.75 ratio。用「回流濃度平衡」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only XR:8→7 kg/m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.6 to 0.75 ratio. Explain the direction using return-sludge concentration balance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 水力與固體雙限制~Hydraulic and solids constraints
units.mechanism: 表面水力負荷與固體通量是不同限制，任一不足都可能帶出污泥。~Hydraulic overflow and solids flux are distinct constraints; either can cause sludge escape.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=3000 m³/d；A=120 m²。模型 SOR=Q/A，代入得到 25 m/d。適用邊界：表面溢流率只是一個水力指標，不能單獨決定絮凝沉降效率。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=3000 m³/d; A=120 m². Model SOR=Q/A gives 25 m/d. Applicability: Surface overflow rate is a hydraulic metric, not a complete predictor of flocculent settling.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「水力與固體雙限制」的觀測點。將流量、池面積與沉降柱結果一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for hydraulic and solids constraints. Compare flow and plan area with settling-column observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 水力尚可便宣布二沉池安全。診斷與介入：比較分池流量及沉降測試，先評估配流是否失衡。~Acceptable hydraulics alone is mistaken for sufficient performance. Diagnostic response: Compare cell flows and settling tests, first checking distribution imbalance.
units.misconception: 表面溢流率低就不會固體超載。~Low overflow rate prevents solids overload.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→4200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 25 變為 35 m/d。用「水力與固體雙限制」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→4200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 25 to 35 m/d. Explain the direction using hydraulic and solids constraints, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 泥毯庫存變動~Sludge-blanket inventory change
units.mechanism: 泥毯上升可能代表固體進入大於移出，需把高度轉成體積及質量趨勢。~Rising blanket can indicate accumulation; convert height to volume/mass trends.
units.model: 原創教學假設：池面積=200 m²；泥毯上升=0.15 m/h；假設均勻。模型 dV/dt=A dh/dt，代入得到 30 m³/h。適用邊界：只是泥毯體積變化，未轉成固體質量，須量固體濃度。~Original teaching assumptions: Area=200 m²; blanket rise=0.15 m/h; assumed uniform. Model dV/dt=A dh/dt gives 30 m³/h. Applicability: Blanket volume change only; solids concentration is needed for mass.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「泥毯庫存變動」的觀測點。以多點泥毯高度排除局部斜面與感測器誤讀。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge-blanket inventory change. Use multiple blanket-height points to exclude a sloped interface or sensor error. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 單支探頭的局部高點被當整池平均。診斷與介入：比較多位置泥毯與固體濃度，查進出固體差額。~One local probe peak is treated as the whole-pool mean. Diagnostic response: Compare spatial blanket/solids measurements and check solids imbalance.
units.misconception: 泥毯高度就是固體質量。~Blanket height equals solids mass.
units.practice: 只改變 dh/dt:0.15→0.25 m/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 30 變為 50 m³/h。用「泥毯庫存變動」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only dh/dt:0.15→0.25 m/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 30 to 50 m³/h. Explain the direction using sludge-blanket inventory change, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 回流與排泥分工~Return versus wasting
units.mechanism: 回流重分配菌體，排泥改變全系統固體年齡，兩種操作不可互換。~Return redistributes biomass; wasting changes system solids age, so the two are not interchangeable.
units.model: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。~Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「回流與排泥分工」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for return versus wasting. Calculate masses independently from wasting flow, solids fraction and effluent TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用回流量替代排泥質量計算污泥齡。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。~Recycle volume substitutes for wasted mass in SRT. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
units.misconception: 回流與排泥具有完全相同功能。~Return and waste sludge have identical functions.
units.practice: 只改變 W:180→230 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 22.5 變為 18 d。用「回流與排泥分工」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only W:180→230 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 22.5 to 18 d. Explain the direction using return versus wasting, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 出水顆粒攜磷~Effluent solids carrying phosphorus
units.mechanism: 固體流失同時攜帶有機物與磷，水相反應正常仍可能出水不良。~Escaping solids carry organics/P even when aqueous reactions work well.
units.model: 原創教學假設：出流水 TSS=10 mg/L；固體含磷率=0.04。模型 Ppart=TSS fP，代入得到 0.4 mg P/L。適用邊界：把固體組成當固定的教學近似；還須加上溶解磷。~Original teaching assumptions: Effluent TSS=10 mg/L; solids P fraction=0.04. Model Ppart=TSS fP gives 0.4 mg P/L. Applicability: Assumes constant solids composition; dissolved P must also be included.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「出水顆粒攜磷」的觀測點。比較過濾前後總磷與 TSS。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effluent solids carrying phosphorus. Compare filtered/unfiltered phosphorus with TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只查正磷酸鹽忽略 TSS。診斷與介入：比較過濾前後磷與 TSS，優先診斷固體逃逸。~Orthophosphate-only analysis misses TSS-related P. Diagnostic response: Compare filtered/unfiltered P and TSS, first diagnosing solids escape.
units.misconception: 生物吸磷好就不用檢查沉澱池。~Good biological uptake eliminates clarifier checks.
units.practice: 只改變 TSS:10→15 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.4 變為 0.6 mg P/L。用「出水顆粒攜磷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TSS:10→15 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.4 to 0.6 mg P/L. Explain the direction using effluent solids carrying phosphorus, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 出水堰及偏流~Weirs and uneven flow
units.mechanism: 均勻溢流有助減少局部高流速，堰上附著與高程誤差都需檢查。~Uniform discharge limits local velocities; inspect deposits and elevation errors.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=3000 m³/d；堰長=40 m。模型 WL=Q/Lw，代入得到 75 m³/(m·d)。適用邊界：平均堰負荷不反映堰板不平與局部流量偏置。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=3000 m³/d; weir length=40 m. Model WL=Q/Lw gives 75 m³/(m·d). Applicability: Mean weir loading does not reveal uneven weirs or local flow bias.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「出水堰及偏流」的觀測點。逐段檢查堰頂高程與出流分布。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for weirs and uneven flow. Check weir crest elevation and discharge distribution segment by segment. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只清潔池面而未檢查堰分配。診斷與介入：對照堰高程與沿堰流量，查局部偏流及附著物。~Surface cleaning overlooks weir distribution. Diagnostic response: Compare weir elevation/local flow and inspect uneven flow/deposits.
units.misconception: 出水堰局部流量不會影響固體逃逸。~Local weir flow never affects solids escape.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→4200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 75 變為 105 m³/(m·d)。用「出水堰及偏流」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→4200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 75 to 105 m³/(m·d). Explain the direction using weirs and uneven flow, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 雨天增流重播~Wet-weather replay
units.mechanism: 在同一固體濃度下增加流量，檢查泥毯、通量及出水峰值。~Increase flow at fixed solids concentration and inspect blanket, flux and effluent peaks.
units.model: 原創教學假設：峰流=6000 m³/d；平均流=3000 m³/d。模型 PF=Qpeak/Qmean，代入得到 2 ratio。適用邊界：平均、瞬時峰與設計事件尺度須標明，不能用日平均代替尖峰。~Original teaching assumptions: Peak flow=6000 m³/d; mean flow=3000 m³/d. Model PF=Qpeak/Qmean gives 2 ratio. Applicability: State averaging and event scales; a daily mean cannot replace a short-term peak.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「雨天增流重播」的觀測點。比較分鐘流量序列與每日累積水量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for wet-weather replay. Compare minute-scale flow with daily total volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只考慮平均固體濃度而漏掉瞬時流量。診斷與介入：用實際峰值歷線重播，查瞬時水位及下游能力。~Average solids obscure instantaneous flow effects. Diagnostic response: Replay actual peak hydrographs and check instantaneous levels/downstream capacity.
units.misconception: 濃度不變就沒有新增沉澱負擔。~Unchanged concentration means no extra clarifier burden.
units.practice: 只改變 Qpeak:6000→7500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2 變為 2.5 ratio。用「雨天增流重播」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qpeak:6000→7500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2 to 2.5 ratio. Explain the direction using wet-weather replay, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 診斷與固體閉合~Diagnosis and solids closure
units.mechanism: 由顯微、沉降、流量與泥毯證據區分膨化、上浮、短流及超載。~Use microscopy, settling, flow and blanket evidence to distinguish bulking, rising sludge, bypass and overload.
units.model: 原創教學假設：進入=15、出流水=2、排泥=12 kg/d。模型 ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge，代入得到 1 kg/d。適用邊界：殘差可能來自儲存、漏算旁流與量測誤差，不能自動當作反應。~Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「診斷與固體閉合」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for diagnosis and solids closure. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 相同濁出水被全部歸因同一菌相。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。~Every turbid effluent is blamed on the same biology. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
units.misconception: 所有出水固體異常都應只增加回流。~Every effluent-solids fault is solved by more recycle.
units.practice: 只改變 Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 0.5 kg/d。用「診斷與固體閉合」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 0.5 kg/d. Explain the direction using diagnosis and solids closure, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
